inputs.text: I came across this update on the West Asia conflict where former Israeli PM advisor Daniel Rubenstein argues a political resolution is vital for success while stressing Israel's unwavering stance against Iran's nuclear and missile programs as an ongoing operation. This really exposes how entrenched power structures in places like Israel lean on endless military posturing to cling to dominance, which only worsens regional inequalities and endangers vulnerable communities instead of advancing the institutional reforms and equitable diplomacy needed to shield ordinary people from these cycles of confrontation rooted in systemic injustice.
